official_title: Proposal for a Regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act) and amending certain Union legislative acts – Consolidated Presidency compromise text

institution_roles.evidence_locator: PDF p. 1 identifies the Presidency as originator and delegations as recipient. The Council association represents the Presidency acting within the Council, without implying Council adoption.

corpus_assessment.inclusion_rationale: Consolidated Presidency compromise in the AI Act negotiation pathway, with separately evidenced public access.
corpus_assessment.researcher_notes: The whole official multilingual manifestation has a French cover and an English legislative annex. The English display title translates the consolidated-version qualifier; the ordinal short label and corpus classification remain analytical. The Presidency is the corporate author and delegations are the recipient, not co-authors. Issue remains 15 June 2022. Council access requests 22/1313 and 22/1307 document public-access replies on 20 June 2022. The dataset guide distinguishes historical reply outcomes from current register availability. This is documented access, not first-ever publication; neither original reply-letter bytes nor a historical binary snapshot is claimed. The supported incoming ST 11124 revision link preserves version lineage.
